findings.finding: Concurrent spec edits changed status while questions were still open.
findings.resolution: Retain merged history, latest accepted decisions and a draft status with explicit outstanding prerequisites.

findings.resolution: GitHub confirms verification PR #1 merged; Report Manager #267 remains open. No product merge is claimed.

findings.source: Hermes query plan and Codex query investigation
findings.finding: The four scripts were described as schema-grounded but do not exist, and the named tables are absent from the canonical schema.
findings.resolution: Preserve agreed scope; remove false mappings; require verified schema/calling-code evidence before coding.

findings.finding: The wrapper had a PowerShell syntax error, unsupported Sarah-script flags and a successful exit for blocked prerequisites.
findings.resolution: Fix the syntax, remove the invalid invocation, label unfinished integrations and return exit 2 on blockage; offline negative checks pass.

findings.finding: One populated report grid was labelled a verified feature, with test-level and observation counts mixed.
findings.resolution: Mark the map draft/preliminary, preserve raw results and add an audit note with TRX counts.

findings.source: Both progress pages and PR #2 reviews
findings.finding: Competing pages retained obsolete questions, unsupported PASS claims, invented refactor guidance and malformed markup.
findings.resolution: Replace them with one generated report, settled decisions and a machine-readable handover; keep re-review pending.

findings.finding: DECISIONS.md and HANDOVER.md were outside the repo and contained stale merged/finished claims.
findings.resolution: Track current versions in the branch; update the local entry points to those current records.

findings.finding: Placeholder accounts and un-commented prose produced GitHub ownership errors.
findings.resolution: Use existing repository collaborators with verified write/admin access for the intended owners.

findings.finding: The workflow assumed removed Sarah write tests, agreed Sandra numbers and a fixture file that was not supplied.
findings.resolution: Use supported current tooling; retain a draft with Kim-owned resource/expected-value gates and mark unsupported legs.

findings.finding: Maintenance scheduling and full nontechnical handover were described more confidently than the evidence supported.
findings.resolution: Mark scheduling deferred and the scenario path drafted until a supervised end-to-end run exists.
